question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'laborious' from given sentence:**

Although gardening is a __laborious __job, but it gives me boundless joy, strenuous happiness and immense satisfaction and I like facile activity.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'facile.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 laborious
 needing a lot of time and effort. (बहुत समय और प्रयास की जरूरत)
 
 

 facile
 easy or too easy; not needing effort. (आसान या बहुत आसान; प्रयास की आवश्यकता नहीं)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• ​​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 boundless
 having no limit. (जिसकी कोई सीमा नहीं है)
 
 

 strenuous
 needing or using a lot of physical or mental effort or energy. (बहुत अधिक शारीरिक या मानसिक प्रयास या ऊर्जा की आवश्यकता या उपयोग करना)
 
 

 immense
 extremely large in size or degree. (आकार या डिग्री में बहुत बड़ा)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'laborious' and 'facile' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 2.
